title: Lior and the Garden
author: Gideon Nystrom
blurb: Mara Dravenmoor, the youngest member of a dying guild, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain before the long winter finishes falling.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
